upcomingEvents.title: Fireside Chat with Michael Korzinstone
upcomingEvents.description: Michael Korzinstone, Partner at Altas Partners, will join McGill Private Capital for a fireside chat on private equity investing, career development and lessons from his experience in the industry.

upcomingEvents.title: Fireside Chat with Daniel Maev
upcomingEvents.description: Daniel Maev, Managing Director in M&A at CIBC Capital Markets, will join McGill Private Capital for a fireside chat on M&A advisory, transaction execution and career development in investment banking.

events.title: Healthcare Investing with Marco Cianflone
events.description: Marco shared perspectives from his path through Harvard and his work in healthcare investing, giving members a closer look at how specialized industry knowledge can inform public-equity underwriting.

events.title: Fireside Chat with Nicholas Moritsugu
events.description: McGill alumnus and ONCAP Principal Nicholas Moritsugu discussed his path through investment banking and North American mid-market private equity, sharing practical lessons on career development and investing.

events.title: Sagard Private Equity Visit
events.description: MPC members met with Sagard’s private equity team in Montreal to discuss selected investments, lower-middle-market private equity and the judgment and preparation required to build a career in the industry.
